title: Figures 87-88: Tic Tac temperature and Mach number at 1300 mph supersonic CFD
description: Two CFD contour plots of the Tic Tac UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K and 1300 mph with supersonic inlet and outlet. Figure 87 shows the temperature field (K) with an elongated heated wake; Figure 88 shows the Mach number field with shock structure and a subsonic wake region. Fastest case in the BAASS Tic Tac speed series.
